## U64 accepted migration plan, freshness and rollback

1. Verify actual merged T01 status and reconcile live controls. Keep the plan
   IMPLEMENTING and workflow DELIVERY_ACTIVE until output evidence permits
   their separate validation transition; no task remains active.
2. Review this exact assessment and control reconciliation. Existing manual
   implementation mode and EXPLICIT_REVIEW stay selected. There is no more
   permissive mode to carry forward or reconfirm.
3. Pre-cutover validation while the old live pin/runtime remain authoritative:
   validate the proposed migration in a disposable checkout, including the
   following manifest-reference and candidate-pin changes. Require 103 tests,
   Markdown/structure, lifecycle, Mermaid, whitespace and candidate provenance
   to pass; verify unchanged accepted hashes and actual between-task status.
   No failed required check permits live cutover.
4. Proposed migration after owner acceptance and those passing checks: bind the historical WB62 batch's
   manifest inventory Path to its already retained
   `.github/spec-driven-delivery/reviews/WB62-P01-reviewed-manifest.snapshot`,
   retaining its existing hash, snapshot and dependency fields. This keeps
   the original planning input immutable instead of claiming the new runtime
   pin was approved in R06. U64, not R06, supplies new-pin acceptance. The
   runtime and live manifest checks remain mandatory for future actions.
   Then update the live manifest pin and upgrade fields to the exact candidate.
   This explicit reference migration is reviewed with U64; no snapshot bytes,
   checker rule, old acceptance or task contract may be changed.
5. After the validated pin change, clean only marker-verified checkouts
   through the installer, regenerate the normal runtime and require CURRENT
   with matching guide, origin, HEAD and installed-skill marker.
6. Record actual result and publish the upgrade controls through required PR
   review/owner merge authority. Reconcile WB62 closure separately.

Dependency order: merged-source evidence -> terminal-task reconciliation ->
assessment acceptance -> pre-cutover migration validation at retained live pin
-> authorized pin/runtime cutover -> post-cutover verification/publication.
No normative design/task input changes, so no new task context is consumed.
Subsequent work must verify its then-current context against the new runtime.

Rollback uses base commit 37653eec1d980e3ea5ed858922ab97894395fab9 and old pin
d93d27a33c43c1574aeed27044654c8964cf998b. Restore only U64 pin/control changes
if cutover fails, retain correct T01 merge evidence and diagnostics, clean only
verified owned runtime, regenerate at the old pin and require CURRENT. Preserve
both Git revisions; no broad reset, archive deletion or unrelated cleanup.

live pin retained. The manifest reference was rebound to the unchanged accepted
WB62 snapshot and the live pin was changed to
`37653eec1d980e3ea5ed858922ab97894395fab9`. Installer cleanup removed only the

No archive, branch deletion or unrelated cleanup occurred during cutover. The
new owned checkout remains available for delivery work. Publication of these
tracked controls is included in the WB62 closure package; until that PR merges,
this branch carries the verified local cutover and main carries only the source.
